items.title: Georg Brunis Interview, 1958-06-03
items.q: Oh yeah, Roy Palmer. Roy Palmer. I never heard of him.

ctx.x: Lomax. Says that my greatest idol was Watson. I never heard of a Watson. Or Roy Palmer, was it? Oh yeah, Roy Palmer. Roy Palmer. I never heard of him.

items.title: Roy Palmer Interview, 1955-09-22
items.q: Oh, no, that boy, I know him. He just come from over in our jays. He come from across the river. We come up together on here.

ctx.x: There's one trombonist there, George Brunus, a white fellow from New Orleans.

Oh, no, that boy, I know him. He just come from over in our jays. He come from across the river. We come up together on here. George Brunus and Milton Brunus, his brother. Yeah. And I forget this other boy. There was another boy come up here with an orchestra.
Paul Merez. Yeah, Paul Merez. Well, there was another trombonist down there, Tom Brown. Yeah, Tom Brown. Oh, he had a band.
